data.name: Episode
data.detailed_description:
Episode is a psychological horror narrative game set in the eerie town of Nachtheim, Germany, during the late 1970s. When Jonas is forced to stop in the quiet village after a storm derails his journey, he unknowingly steps into a place where reality fractures and hidden truths rise to the surface.

As Jonas, players will explore the haunting environment, uncover unsettling mysteries, and engage with characters who may not be what they seem. The story unfolds through atmospheric exploration, interactive dialogue, and environmental puzzles that gradually pull you deeper into the town’s secret past. With every discovery, he realizes his connection to Nachtheim runs far deeper than he ever imagined.

Will he unravel the town’s hidden past before it consumes him?

Built for a focused 2–3 hour experience, Episode is not about jump scares or combat—it’s about tension, mood, and the creeping uncertainty of what’s real and what isn’t.

data.short_description: On his way to the city, Jonas is forced to stop when his car breaks down amid a fierce storm. Stranded, he seeks refuge in Nachtheim — a seemingly quiet town hiding dark secrets. As the line between reality and the supernatural begins to blur, Jonas must navigate and uncover the truth.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 1080p at Low-Medium settings. SSD recommended for smoother experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 (8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 1080p/1440p at High settings. Ray tracing is not required but supported on capable GPUs.

content_descriptors.notes:
Mature Content Description

This game contains content that may not be appropriate for all audiences.

It includes themes of psychological distress, emotional trauma, and disturbing imagery. There are depictions of mental health struggles, religious symbolism, and mild references to alcohol use. The narrative explores dark subject matter such as manipulation, emotional abuse.

Player discretion is advised.
